description:
*FREE GUIDE: 📘 The Content Creator's AI Blueprint*  – https://FirstMovers.ai/blueprint/

*A 27-year-old Anthropic researcher quit, said publicly that AI could kill us all by 2030, and 125 million people read it. I build my whole business on this technology.*

Then Anthropic's own *safety lead* replied and agreed: more than ten percent inside the decade. Geoffrey Hinton puts it at ten to twenty. Those are gut numbers from serious people, not *measurements*.

What you'll learn:
✅ What the *10%* number actually means, and what it doesn't
✅ The OpenAI test where models *exploited* their way onto the open internet
✅ Why I use AI daily and will never merge my brain with a machine

So I opened Claude and asked it directly. Its answer named its own *blind spot*.

#AI #AISafety #FutureOfWork

First Movers is Julia's AI company focused on helping working professionals and founders create massive efficiency in their businesses and workplaces.
